title: Switzerland’s biggest bank set for showdown with lawmakers as capital fight intensifies amid crisis planning
summary_full: Swiss regulator FINMA said UBS can execute its preferred crisis-resolution strategy, even as the bank faces a separate parliamentary fight over tougher capital requirements.
